chat.noAccount: {name} has no signed-in account to chat with.
signIn.title: Sign in to {name}
signIn.step1: 1. Open the {host} authorization page and sign in there, then allow the sign-in.
signIn.step2: 2. The page then sends the browser to {callback}, which shows an error because nothing listens there. That is expected: copy the full address from the browser's address bar.
signIn.paste.label: The address the browser ended on
signIn.paste.hint: It starts with the address above and carries the sign-in. Treat it like a password.
signIn.nothing: That address carries no sign-in. Paste the whole address, including everything after the ?
signIn.note: This sign-in uses device {id}; Trae sees every request from that device.
